GET /api/agents.name: Code Reviewer Agent

GET /api/agents.name: Eval Agent

environments.description: A research group tests one question. Hypotheses form a tree, experiments are Python programs run in the code sandbox against a budget, their metrics build a dataset, and the group writes a report. Ends when every root hypothesis is confirmed or refuted, or when the budget runs out.

params.name: question
params.description: The research question the group works on.

params.name: max_experiments
params.description: Experiment budget: how many runs the group may make.

params.name: experiment_timeout
params.description: Seconds one experiment program may run.

params.name: seed_experiments
params.description: Hand every run a seed on stdin, so a repeat is reproducible.

actions.name: propose_hypothesis
actions.description: Propose a hypothesis. Give parent_id to refine an existing one.

actions.name: design_experiment
actions.description: Design an experiment for a hypothesis. code is a Python program: it reads {"params": ..., "seed": ...} as JSON from stdin and must print one JSON object of numeric metrics as its last stdout line. No network; keep it short enough to finish within the timeout.

actions.name: run_experiment
actions.description: Run a designed experiment in the sandbox. Costs one unit of budget.

actions.name: analyze
actions.description: Record your analysis of a finished experiment and the metrics you read from it.

actions.name: critique
actions.description: Critique a hypothesis or an experiment, by id.

actions.name: decide
actions.description: Decide a hypothesis: verdict is confirmed, refuted or needs_repeat.

actions.name: write_up
actions.description: Write (or rewrite) one section of the report.

actions.name: add_formula
actions.description: Add a formula to the report, as LaTeX.

actions.name: speak_to
actions.description: Send a message to a colleague (delivered next tick).

actions.name: observe
actions.description: Do nothing this tick.

environments.description: A continuous double auction. Agents submit limit orders; a real matching engine crosses them by price-time priority. Cash and shares are conserved.

params.name: fundamental_value
params.description: The 'true' value. Agents see a noisy private estimate of it.

params.name: value_noise
params.description: Spread of private value estimates. Zero means everyone agrees and nothing trades.

params.name: max_order_size
params.description: Largest quantity one order may carry.

actions.name: submit_order
actions.description: Place a limit order. Buying requires cash; selling requires shares.

actions.name: cancel_orders
actions.description: Cancel all of your resting orders.

actions.name: speak_to
actions.description: Send a message to another agent (delivered next tick).

actions.name: hold
actions.description: Do nothing this tick.

environments.description: Locations, inventories, relationships and secrets. Characters move, talk, trade items and change how they feel about each other.

params.name: starting_location
params.description: Where everyone begins. Blank scatters them.

params.name: starting_items
params.description: Items dealt out to characters at the start.

params.name: hours_per_tick
params.description: How much in-world time one tick advances.

actions.name: move_to
actions.description: Move to another location.

actions.name: follow
actions.description: Go where another character goes. If they are here you leave with them; if they left your location last tick you go after them. Use this instead of guessing which room someone walked off to.

actions.name: speak_to
actions.description: Say something to another character (delivered next tick). They must be in your location, and they must still be there when the tick ends — someone who walks out this tick does not hear you, and you are told that they left.

actions.name: announce
actions.description: Say something to everyone still in your location.

actions.name: give_item
actions.description: Give an item you hold to someone in your location. If they leave this tick the item stays with you.

actions.name: set_attitude
actions.description: Record how you now feel about someone (-2 hostile to +2 devoted).

actions.name: observe
actions.description: Watch and say nothing this tick.

spec.markdown:
# August content report

## Content

The catalog, product and about pages were reviewed this month. The Trailpack
32L was renamed from "Rucksack 32" everywhere, including the sample sales
data, so the name is consistent end to end.

## Sales

Backpacks were the top revenue category in August ($1,780), ahead of Bottles
($1,200) and Maps ($645), even though Bottles sold in higher volume. See the
attached chart and table for the day-by-day breakdown.

## Next

Add a one-line description per product on the catalog page, and a short note
on materials to explain the Trailpack's price.

messages.content: How did August sales break down by category?
Backpacks led at $1,780, ahead of Bottles at $1,200 and Maps at $645. I put together a chart of it.
What does the Fernweh & Co. sample shop actually sell?

It sells three things: the Trailpack 32L backpack, the Summit Bottle and the Ridge Map Pack. Here's the storefront's product list:

```python
PRODUCTS = [
    {"slug": "trailpack-32", "name": "Trailpack 32L", "price": 89.00, "category": "Backpacks"},
    {"slug": "summit-bottle", "name": "Summit Bottle 1L", "price": 24.00, "category": "Bottles"},
    {"slug": "ridge-map-pack", "name": "Ridge Map Pack", "price": 15.00, "category": "Maps"},
]
```

Backpacks bring in the most revenue this month even though Bottles sell in higher volume, since the Trailpack costs more per unit.
